question: According to Census of India 2011, how much per cent of the total population were Sikhs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1.7%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the data from the 2011 Census of India, **Sikhs make up 1.7%** of India's total population.
 
• Sikhism is one of the most significant religions in India, primarily concentrated in the state of **Punjab**.
 
• It is India's **fourth-largest religious group**. 
 
• India's Sikh population stands at 20.8 million, which is only 1.72% of the country's total population.
 
• Out of approximately 25-30 million Sikhs in the world, the majority of them, 20.8-22 million, live in India which is about (83.2%-84.1%) of the world's Sikh population.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hindus** constitute the majority of India's population, with an overall share of **79.8%**.
 
• **Muslims** are the largest religious minority in India, amounting to **14.2% **of the population.
 
• **Christians** make up **2.3%** of India's population.
 
• **Sikhs** constitute **1.7%** of the population.
 
• **Buddhists** make up** 0.7%** of the population, while **Jains** account for** 0.4%**.
 
• 0.9% of the population follow other religions, including tribal faiths often categorized under 'Other Religions and Persuasions.'
 
• A small proportion, 0.2% of the population, did not state their religion.
